title: Weighted approximate tangent spaces pass to and from a subset at almost every point of the subset
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and H := μHE[k] on ℝ^N = Eucl N. Let E ⊆ M ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable sets and let θ : ℝ^N → ℝ be H-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N (no sign condition on θ and no local finiteness of H⌞M is assumed). Then for H-a.e. x ∈ E (that is, H⌞E-almost every x) and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^N: Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.7 (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q: finrank Q = k and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f(y)θ(x + ry) dH(y) → θ(x)∫_Q f dH as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x)) if and only if Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (E, θ) at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ), E ⊆ M → NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q ↔ HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q
